hook: Frege's election method settles into a finite polygon attractor, mapped by Farey fractions for three parties.
summary: The authors treat a proportional seat-allocation rule as a dynamical system. For almost every vote vector it has a unique attractor made of polytopes, and for three parties they construct the invariant polygons and chart how they change across Farey cells. They also show the discrepancy bound stays sharp for fixed vote shares. Results are exact mathematics for the method only and exclude exceptional vote vectors.
title: Frege's election method: discrepancy, invariant polygons and Farey geometry
